selection: Highest native validation mean within budget; earliest checkpoint breaks ties. Every seed must pass common validation seeds 10000..10100 before held-out evaluation. Highest common-validation mean selects bundle; lowest training seed breaks ties.

recipe.selection: Highest native validation mean within budget; earliest checkpoint breaks ties. Every seed must pass common validation seeds 10000..10100 before held-out evaluation. Highest common-validation mean selects bundle; lowest training seed breaks ties.
recipe.hardware: T490 Intel Core i7-8565U, 4 cores / 8 threads; concurrent training jobs
recipe.changes_from_v1: Evaluate100 episodes; stop training at validation mean-90. Network, optimizer, observations, dynamics, rewards, seeds, and 1M budget are unchanged.

normalization: Angular velocities divided by float32(4*pi) and float32(9*pi); trigonometric observations unchanged.
reward: Original environment return for charts and qualification; gamma*next_height_potential - current_height_potential added only to training reward, scale 10, terminal potential zero.

compatibility.probes: Seeds 20000..20003, first 32 transitions, native and browser-trained policies, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.
compatibility.record_note: The native file recorder and in-memory recorder have different metadata; canonical export preserves parameters and is identical across targets.
